observed_failure: Numeric value mismatch for object Bodies: 'Sum: 6.06775878802135438e+00' vs 'Sum: 3.00021548081332554e+01'
finding: The fused CUDA force/integration kernel reads source positions and overwrites updated target positions in the same global Body array. Shared-memory barriers are block-local, so a block can update positions while another block still needs their old values. The uneven local workload exposes this pre-existing cross-block read/write race.
interpretation: Exclusive execution and internal finite-value validation succeed, but independent numerical validation fails. Retain failed external validation without retry or source changes.
investigation: Static source inspection and retained exclusive numerical failure; no new program execution.
